title: Rabit Aimpire al-thabit al-khass bik
body: Iftah https://aitech.ibportal.io/profile w insakh rabit Partner al-khass bik — hadha al-rabit, la ayy rabit akhar. W shakluh hakadha: copyxapp.com/auth/register?e=… Alsiqh huna. Yahsul al-qada al-mu3tamadun 3ala rabit thabit wahid ya3rid hadhihi al-safha kamila bi-jami3 al-lughat, w ismuhum w rabituhum muthabbatan fih — la yastati3 ahad mimman yaftahuh taghyirahuma.
ok: Tamm al-naskh. Hadha huwa rabitak al-thabit — sharik hadha al-rabit.
bad: Hadha laysa rabit Partner ma3rufan. Yajib an yabda' bi https:// w an yakun ma'khudhan min safhat Profile fi IB Portal.
name_hint: Yudaf ismak al-awwal ila al-talab. W tazhar asma' al-qada al-mu3tamadin li-man yad3unahum.
pending: Lasta mu3tamadan ba3d. Idghat «Utlub al-i3timad», fa-yasil ismak w rabitak ila al-mu'assis.
applied: Tamm al-irsal. Hadha huwa rabitak — ihfazuh al-an. W yabda' al-3amal lahzat an ya3tamidak al-mu'assis.
apply_fail: Ta3adhdhar al-irsal. Tahaqqaq min ittisalak bil-internet w hawil marra ukhra.
pending_line: Lasta fi qa'imat al-qada al-mu3tamadin ba3d. Tamm naskh hadha al-talab — arsilh ila al-mu'assis. Ba3d idafatak, alsiq rabitak huna marra ukhra.
applied_wait: La ya'mal ba'd? Izan lam ya'tamidka al-founder ba'd. Wa marrat sa'a wa la shay'? Izan lam yasilna talabuka — arsilhu marra ukhra.
why: Istakhdim rabit Partner min safhat Profile fi IB Portal. Al-rabit al-mansukh min ayy makan akhar la yarbut 3udwak bi Tag Markets, w sayadtarr ila al-tasjil min jadid 3abr AiTech.
mail_hint: We email you when your link goes live. Nothing else.

Fil-trading khatar, w yumkin an takhsar al-mal alladhi tudi3uh. W la shay' huna yu3add financial advice, w la wa3d bi-ayy dakhl. W la tastakhdim illa malan tahtamil khasaratah, w raji3 al-qawanin al-sariya fi balad iqamatak.

Aimpire mujtama' lil-ta'allum. Lasna broker, wa la nastaqbil iida'at, wa la nudiru amwal ahad, wa la nuqaddim nasiha maliyya.

Qawa'id al-tadawul ma'a broker fi balad akhar laysat wahida fi kull makan, wa fi ba'd al-buldan hiya muqayyada. I'rif ma yantabiq haythu tuqim qabla an tada' amwalak — fa-dhalika al-qarar, wa ma yatarattab 'alayhi, qararuka anta. Wa al-qada huna yusharikuna ma ta'allamuh; la yuqaddimuna nasiha, wa la yatawallawna amwal ahad. Kull ma yusharak fi al-mujtama' — rusum, amthila, signals — huwa lil-ta'allum, li-tahkum anta bi-nafsik; wa laysa abadan tawsiya bil-shira' aw al-bay'.

lede:
Tastaghriq al-khutuwat 1–4 nahwa khams 3ashrata daqiqa. Ij3al bitaqat hawiyatak aw jawaz safarak fi mutanawal yadak.

steps: Istakhdim rabit al-sponsor al-khass bik

Iftah al-rabit alladhi arsalah lak al-sponsor — rabituh huwa, la rabitan min majmu3a.
Fi a3la hadhihi al-safha yajib an tara satran yadhkur ismah, w yantahi bi-ramz min sitta ahruf w arqam.
La tara hadha al-satr? Utlub min al-sponsor an yursil lak rabitah qabl an tukmil.

steps.check: Yazhar fil-a3la ismun, aw nitaqun w sitta ahruf w arqam. W ghiyab al-satr ya3ni annahu la yujad sponsor murtabit bik.

steps: Anshi' hisabak

Marrir ila al-a3la w idghat al-zirr al-kabir li-fath hisabak. Yuftah CopyX fi tabwib jadid.
Istakhdim ismak al-haqiqi — yajib an yutabiq hawiyatak. W ikhtar password la tastakhdimuh fi ayy makan akhar.
Ghayyir Country min Albania ila balad iqamatak; fa-miftah al-hatif yatba3uh.
Da3 3alama fil-murabba3ayn, w intazir hatta yantahi «Verifying…», thumma idghat Sign Up.

marks.t: Ismak al-haqiqi. Yajib an yutabiq al-hawiya allati tarfa3uha lahiqan, w illa fasayafshal al-tahaqquq.
Ikhtar password la tastakhdimuh fi ayy makan akhar — w la tastakhdim nafs password baridak al-iliktruni.
3allim al-murabba3ayn. Iqra'huma awwalan — fahuma yanussan 3ala annak qad takhsar malak.
Idha ra'ayt hadha al-murabba3 al-asfar, farabitak kan yanqusuh ramz al-da3wa. Irja3 w iftah rabit al-sponsor badalan minh.
Hadhihi al-khana ta'ti muhaddada 3ala Albania 3ind al-jami3. Ghayyirha — famiftah al-hatif yataghayyar ma3aha.

steps.check: Tasil ila dakhil al-portal w tara ismak anta.

steps: Urbut hisab al-broker — hadhihi al-khutwa muhimma

Dakhil al-portal, istakhdim zirr Login to CopyX li-insha' hisab Tag Markets al-khass bik.
La tunshi'h fi ayy makan akhar — fal-hisab alladhi yunsha' fi makan akhar la yakun murtabitan, w la yutatabba3 ayy shay' bi-shakl sahih.

steps.note: W al-portal yaqul dhalik aydan: istakhdim dhalik al-zirr faqat.
steps.alt: Lawhat tasjil CopyX dakhil al-IB Portal

marks.t: Iqra' hadha al-satr. Fahuwa yatlub minnak an tunshi' hisab al-broker min huna, la min ayy makan akhar.
Hadha huwa al-zirr. Maktub 3alayh Login to CopyX — istakhdimh hatta fil-marra al-ula.
Al-tahdhir bil-asfar: hisab Tag Markets alladhi yunsha' mubasharatan 3ala CopyX lan yakun murtabitan bi-hisabak huna.

steps.check: Yazhar hisab Tag Markets dakhil al-portal. W in udturirt ila tasjil al-dukhul fi makan akhar li-tajidah, fahuwa ghayr murtabit.

steps: Akkid hawiyatak

Tahtaj ila bitaqat hawiyatak aw jawaz safarak, idafatan ila mash lil-wajh.
Sawwir al-mustanad fi daw' jayyid bihaythu tazhar zawayah al-arba3 — fal-sura ghayr al-wadiha hiya al-sabab al-mu3tad lil-rafd.

marks.t: Ikhtar naw3 al-mustanad min huna awwalan. La yurfa3 shay' qabl dhalik.
Hadha al-satr al-asfar tabi3i qabl al-raf3. W huwa laysa khata'an.
Kalimat Validate ta3ni ann al-broker lam yafhas mustanadatak ba3d.

steps.check: Ikhtafa al-satr al-asfar «upload» w zahar mustanadak mursalan. W «Validate» ya3ni faqat anna al-broker lam yanzur ba3d.

steps: Intazir al-muwafaqa

Tastaghriq al-muwafaqa 3adatan waqtan qasiran.
W hatta dhalik al-hin la yumkinuk al-ida3 — w al-tanbih fi safhat al-wallet tabi3i, w laysa khata'an.

steps.alt: Safhat al-wallet tuzhir wujub ikmal KYC awwalan

marks.t: Hadha al-satr al-zahri ya3ni ann al-tahaqquq ma zal qayd al-intizar. W yakhtafi ba3d al-muwafaqa 3ala mustanadatak.

steps.check: Ikhtafa al-satr al-zahri fi safhat al-wallet w sar bil-imkan al-daght 3ala Deposit.

steps: Athna' al-intizar: thabbit al-tatbiqayn

Istafid min waqt al-intizar li-tathbit tatbiqayn, min al-matajir al-rasmiya faqat — al-azrar adnah ta'khudhak ilayha mubashara.
MetaTrader 5, li-tara hisabak (al-khutwa 9).
Element X, li-majmu3at Aimpire (al-khutwa 10).
Ya3mal Tag Markets w CopyX w al-IB Portal fil-mutasaffih. La tuthabbit abadan «Tag Markets app» yursiluh lak ahad.

steps.check: Yuftah kila al-tatbiqayn 3ala hatifak. W la haja ila tasjil al-dukhul ba3d.

steps: Awdi3 al-mal

Fil-portal idghat Deposit, w ikhtar al-mablagh (al-hadd al-adna $10) w al-3umla al-raqmiya allati tamlikuha.
Satahsul 3ala 3unwan w ramz QR w shabaka w 3add tanazuli muddatuh nahwa khams 3ashrata daqiqa.
Arsil min mihfazatak anta — Binance aw RedotPay aw ma yushbihuhuma. Qad tatlub Face ID aw ramzan; hadha tahaqquq khass bi-mihfazatak.
Intaha al-3add? Utlub 3unwanan jadidan; w la tu3id istikhdam al-qadim abadan.

steps.note:
Arsil 3ala al-shabaka allati tadhkuruha safhat al-daf3 bil-dabt. W mihfazatak nafsuha tuhadhdhir min anna 3adam tatabuq al-shabaka qad ya3ni «permanent loss of funds».
Al-maqbula: Ethereum (ERC20) w Polygon w Tron (TRC20) w BNB (BEP20) w Bitcoin w Polkadot w Solana. W laysa Arbitrum.
Al-rusum takhtalif: irsal 25 USDC 3abr Ethereum kallaf 1.00 USDC, ay arba3a fil-mi'a.
steps.check: Yazhar al-mablagh fi safhat al-wallet fil-portal. Qad tuzhir mihfazatak «Pending» li-ba3d al-waqt — hatta 24 sa3a bi-hasab taqdiriha al-khass. Lam yazhar ba3daha? Tahaqqaq min al-3amaliya fi mihfazatak anta awwalan.

steps: Urbut hisabak bi Sonic copy trading

Hadhihi al-khutwa tabda' al-naskh — w qablaha la yajri ayy tadawul.
Fi Tag Markets iftah CopyX, w ibhath 3an SONIC w idghat Details. Ta3rid al-bitaqa al-shurut: rasm ada' 30 %, w shahr wahid ka-hadd adna, w la rusum idara w la rusum indimam.
Idghat Connect, w uktub al-mablagh ($10 3ala al-aqall) w ikhtar Amplify.
Fi Community Token uktub #Aitech w idghat Verify, thumma uktub 000000 fi Hash w idghat Submit.
3allim al-murabba3ayn w idghat Copy Now.

steps.note: Ma3 al-token yatadawal al-hisab bi-24× — fa-mablaghuna $109 sar $2,616 — w yughlaq 3ind khasarat 5 % badal 10 %. La tada3 illa ma tastati3 khasaratah kamilan.
steps.check: Yazhar «CopyX Account Created» — idghat Continue, fayazhar SONIC fi lawhatak. Al-mablagh $0? Idhan lam yaktamil Submit.

quiz.q: Mablaghak yutadawal bi-muda3if 24×. W rasid al-tadawul yahbut 4.2 %. Fakam yabqa min mablaghak?
quiz.why: La yabqa shay'. 3ind 24×, hubut 4.2 % fil-rasid huwa kamil mablaghak — famablaghuna al-baligh $109 kan yutadawal ka'annahu $2,616. W yughlaq al-hisab min tilqa' nafsih 3ind 5 %. W al-mablagh alladhi tada3uh huwa al-juz' alladhi tatahakkam fih.

steps: Raqib hisabak fi MetaTrader 5

Fil-portal iftah MT5 Credentials: raqm al-hisab, w Master Password, w Investor Password.
Fi MetaTrader 5 adif hisaban mawjudan, w ibhath 3an T.M. Financials Ltd w ikhtar TMFinancials-Server.
Ism al-dukhul huwa raqm al-hisab. Ba3daha tara Balance w Equity w Free Margin.

steps.note: Al-Master Password yutih al-tadawul; amma al-Investor Password fayutih al-mushahada faqat. La tu3ti al-Master Password li-ayy ahad abadan. W in kan 3ala ahad an yattali3 3ala nata'ijak, fa'a3tih al-Investor Password.
steps.check: Yutabiq Balance al-raqm fil-portal w yakun 24 di3f ida3ak — mablaghuna $109 zahar bi-qimat $2,616. Laysa 24 di3fan? Tawaqqaf w is'al al-sponsor al-khass bik.

steps: Indamm ila al-majmu3a

Fil-majmu3a tajid ijabat as'ilatak — fala ahad hunak bada' w huwa ya3rif shay'an.
Satudif malan lahiqan? Adifh 3ala dafa3at saghira.

apps.lede: Thabbit Element X — hadha al-tatbiq bil-dhat, la Element Classic w la ayy tatbiq muhadatha akhar. Anshi' hisaban bi-ayy ism mustakhdim. Thumma 3ud ila huna w idghat «Indamm ila majmu3at Aimpire».

steps.check: Tastati3 qira'at al-rasa'il, la ru'yat ism al-majmu3a faqat.

t: Huna tujad arqamak al-haqiqiya. W idha ikhtalaf raqm fi risala 3ala al-chat 3amma tarah fi hadhihi al-shasha, fal-shasha hiya al-sahiha.

Sayakun ladayk hisaban tusajjil bihima al-dukhul. W ma3rifat al-farq baynahuma tujannibak mu3zam al-iltibas.
Al-minassa allati tansakh safaqat al-traders. Tunshi' hisabak fiha awwalan, fil-khutwa 2.
Haythu tajid fariqak w arqamak. W tadkhul ilayh bi-nafs bayanat al-dukhul ila CopyX.
Al-broker — al-sharika allati tahtafiz bi-malak fi3lan. Tunshi' hisabak fiha min dakhil al-portal, fil-khutwa 3.

all_done: Unjizat al-khutuwat al-{total} kulluha. Anta jahiz.

La tahtaj ila shay' min hadha li-tatruk Sonic ya3mal. Huwa huna li-ta3ud ilayh hin turid an tafham ma tanzur ilayh. Idghat 3ala ayy kalima li-taftahaha.
Al-wahda allati yataharrak biha al-si3r — al-khana al-3ushriya al-rabi3a fi mu3zam al-azwaj.
3ala EUR/USD, 1.0850 → 1.0851 tusawi pip wahida. W 3ind 0.01 lot tusawi $0.10.
Kull hadaf w natija tasma3uha tudhkar bil-pips — w 3adad al-pips la ya3ni shay'an hatta ta3rif al-lot size khalfah.
3ushr al-pip. W ba3d al-minassat ta3rid al-points badalan minha.
«+500 points» 3ala EUR/USD ta3ni 50 pips. W 3ind 0.01 lot fahiya $5, la $500.
Hadha huwa al-khalt alladhi yaj3al natija mutawadi3a tabdu akbar 3ashr marrat. Tahaqqaq min al-wahda qabl an tuqarin arqamak bi-arqam ayy shakhs akhar.
Al-fariq bayn si3r al-shira' w si3r al-bay3. Tadfa3uh lahzat al-dukhul.
Shira' 1.08515 w bay3 1.08500 yusawi 1.5 pip. W 3ind 0.01 lot fadhalik $0.15 li-kull safqa.
Kull safqa tabda' muta'akhkhira bi-miqdar al-spread, rabihat am khasirat. W 3ashr safaqat yawmiyan 3ala hisab saghir taklifa haqiqiya.
spread cost = spread in pips × pip value
Hajm ma tatadawaluh. W huwa yuhaddid qimat al-haraka al-wahida — w laysa al-raqm nafsuh 3ala kull adah.
EUR/USD: 1.00 lot ≈ $10 li-kull pip, w 0.01 ≈ $0.10. W al-dhahab (XAUUSD): 1.00 lot = 100 unsa, faharaka bi $1 tusawi $100.

Huwa al-raqm al-wahid alladhi yuqarrir in kanat haraka 3adiya mujarrad iz3aj am nihayat al-hisab — w huwa yakhtalif bayn adah w ukhra. W sijill Sonic nafsuh 3ala al-dhahab, la 3ala zawj 3umlat. Faqabl an tuhaddid al-hajm, tahaqqaq min al-qima al-haqiqiya: fi MT5 iftah Specification al-khassa bil-ramz (3ala al-kumbyutar: idghat bil-zirr al-ayman 3ala al-ramz).
pip/point value = lots × contract size × tick     EURUSD → $10 · XAUUSD → $100
Al-leverage huwa hajm al-safqa al-masmuh lak bi-fathiha. W al-margin huwa al-juz' al-mahjuz min malak ma damat maftuha.
Safqat 0.01 lot 3ala EUR/USD tusawi nahwa $1,085. W 3ind 1:300 yuhjaz laha nahwa $3.60 min malak.
Al-leverage al-a3la la yuqallil al-khatar. Kull ma yaf3aluh annahu yuharrir juz'an min al-margin, fayusmah lak bi-fath al-mazid.
Al-balance mal al-safaqat al-mughlaqa. W al-equity huwa dhalik, za'idan aw naqisan kull ma zal maftuhan.
Balance $100, w safqa wahida khasira 40 pip 3ind 0.01 lot (−$4) → equity $96.
Al-balance huwa al-madi. W al-equity huwa mawqi3ak al-fi3li al-an. W al-khasara al-3a'ima khasara haqiqiya lam tuqayyad ba3d.
equity = balance + open profit − open loss
Hin yahbit al-equity bima yakfi muqaranatan bil-margin alladhi tatatallabuh safaqatak, yughliquha al-broker niyabatan 3ank.
Hisab bi $100 yahmil khasara 3a'ima $60 yatabaqqa lah $40 min al-equity.
3ind al-stop out la takhtar anta lahzat al-khuruj. Tuthabbat al-khasara hinaha, w ghaliban 3ind aswa' nuqta.
Amr qa'im bil-ighlaq 3ind si3r ikhtartah musbaqan, fatatawaqqaf al-khasara 3an al-numuw.
Shira' 3ind 1.0850 ma3 stop 3ind 1.0830 yusawi 20 pip. W 3ind 0.01 lot fadhalik $2 tukhatir biha — qarrartaha qabl al-dukhul.
Min dunih yatahaddad hajm khasaratak bi-miqdar ma tahtamil al-nazar ilayha.
risk = stop in pips × pip value
Al-limit yantazir si3ran afdal. W al-stop la yunaffadh illa ba3d an yakhtariq al-si3r mustawan mu3ayyanan.
Al-si3r 1.0850. Buy Limit 3ind 1.0830 yunaffadh in habat al-si3r. W Buy Stop 3ind 1.0870 yunaffadh in sa3id.

Al-isharat tunshar bi-hadha al-ikhtisar: Buy Limit w Buy Stop w Sell Limit w Sell Stop. W ikhtiyar al-naw3 al-khati' min bayn al-arba3a ya3ni imma alla yunaffadh al-amr abadan, w imma an tuftah safqatak fil-lahza al-khati'a.
Al-mablagh — la al-pips — alladhi taqbal khasaratah fi safqa wahida.
Hisab $100, w 0.01 lot, w stop bi 20 pip = $2 tukhatir biha. Ay 2 bil-mi'a.
3ala hisab bi $100 fa'inna asghar hajm qabil lil-tadawul yukhatir aslan bi-3iddat bil-mi'a fil-safqa. W nasihat «khatir bi-wahid bil-mi'a» la tunasib ba3d.
Miqdar hubut al-equity 3an a3la nuqta balaghaha, bil-nisba al-mi'awiya.
Min $100 ila $60 hubut 40 bil-mi'a. W al-3awda ila $100 tahtaj ribhan 67 bil-mi'a, la 40.
Al-khasara w al-ta3wid laysa mutanazirayn. W silsila min al-khasa'ir al-saghira qad tatrukak bi-haja ila 3a'id lam tuhaqqiqh yawman.
gain needed = loss ÷ (1 − loss)   →   khasarat 40 % tahtaj ila istirdad 67 %
Tark al-arbah fil-hisab, fayanmu hajm al-safqa ma3 al-rasid badal an yabqa thabitan.
$100 bi-nisbat 5 bil-mi'a shahriyan ma3 tark al-ribh tasir nahwa $180 ba3d sana, la $160.
Hiya al-hujja al-sadiqa lil-sabr 3ala hisab saghir — w hiya aydan muharrik kull khutta ghayr waqi3iya satu3rad 3alayk.
Durus atwal, mawdu' sadiq wahid fi kull marra. Kull ma huna lil-ta'allum — wa la shay' minhu nasiha.

Ala EUR/USD al-pip huwa al-khana al-'ushriyya al-rabi'a: 1.0850 → 1.0851. Ma'a 1.00 lot yusawi al-pip nahwa $10; wa ma'a 0.01 lot nahwa $0.10. Al-dhahab yusa''ar bi-tariqa ukhra: ma'a 1.00 lot tusawi harakat $1 fi si'r al-dhahab nahwa $100 — fa-fakkir bil-dollar la bil-pips fi al-dhahab wal-naft.
Satran, wa huma yuhaddidan al-hajm — la mizajuk. Qarrib da'iman ila al-asfal ila asghar khutwat lot, wa 'adatan hiya 0.01.

Risk in $ = account × risk % / 100
Lots = risk in $ / (stop distance in pips × pip value per lot)

Hisab $100, mukhatara 2 % = $2. Al-stop 'ala bu'd 20 pip fi EUR/USD. Al-natija 0.01 lot — asghar hajm mawjud. Li-hadha la makan fi al-hisabat al-saghira li-stop ab'ad aw hajm akbar: al-hisab huwa ma yuhaddid al-hajm, la al-shaja'a.

In a'tat al-mu'adala aqall min 0.01 — mathalan hisab $50 wa stop bi-40 pip → 0.0025 lot — fa-hatta asghar hajm yukhatir bi-akthar mimma ikhtart. Al-khiyaran al-sadiqan: stop aqrab lahu sabab, aw tark tilka al-safqa. Fard 0.01 raghma dhalik yaj'al nisbat mukhataratuka umniya, la i'dadan.
Ba'd al-minassat ta'udd bil-points: 10 points = 1 pip. Harakat «100 points» hiya 10 pips. Khaltuhuma yaj'al kull hisab khati'an bi-'asharat ad'af — tahaqqaq ayyuhuma ta'riduhu minassatuk.
